title: Wayfare Pass Billing Standard — Netting Pass Benefit From Window Refunds
content:
# Netting Pass benefit from window refunds — Wayfare Pass (rider membership)

**Standard.** When a Wayfare Pass period fee is refunded under the full refund window, the benefit netting depends on the plan: on an annual plan the netted benefit is the Pass ride credit earned on trips completed in the period in force, less the credit forfeited or corrected on trips of that period; on a monthly plan on which Pass ride credit was spent on fares in the period, the netted benefit is the credit spent in the period; otherwise nothing is netted.

The netted benefit is withheld from the window refund.

## Plans and records

| Plan | Billing period | Netted benefit |
|---|---|---|
| Wayfare Pass Annual, Wayfare Pass Plus Annual, Wayfare Pass All Access Annual | annual | credit earn entries for the period in force, less the credit forfeiture entries of the trip-refund kind for that period |
| Wayfare Pass Student, Wayfare Pass Monthly, Wayfare Pass Plus Monthly | monthly | credit spent entries for the period in force, where there are any; otherwise nothing |

All entries are those on the membership ledger whose billing period is the period in force.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical)

1. Wayfare Pass Plus Annual: credit earn entries for the period total 14.20, and one trip-refund forfeiture for the period is 1.10. Netted benefit: 13.10.
2. Wayfare Pass Monthly: 3.50 of credit spent on fares in the period. Netted benefit: 3.50.
3. Wayfare Pass Monthly: credit earned in the period but none spent. Nothing is netted.
4. Wayfare Pass All Access Annual with no credit earned in the period: nothing to net.
